name: Dairy
overview: Scripture highlights dairy as a symbol of God's provision and blessing, describing the Promised Land as "flowing with milk and honey" to emphasize its abundance and goodness (Exodus 3:8; 33:3). The hospitality shown by Abraham, who served butter and milk alongside a prepared calf, reflects the significance of dairy products in daily life and fellowship (Genesis 18:8). Additionally, the repeated command not to seethe a kid in its mother's milk (Exodus 23:19; 34:26; Deuteronomy 14:21) underscores a divine principle of respect for life and holiness, setting apart God's people through obedience to His instructions.
